notes.title: Now live: Necrology, an easier way to access the beta and bugfixes
notes.notes: [h2]Necrology (currently in the beta only!)[/h2][p]We've added a necrology to the game![/p][p]This lists all your fallen soldiers, along with the cause of their deaths. Deaths are easy to miss sometimes, and as a new player their cause might not be fully understood, so this should help you figure out why a soldier might have fallen and how to avoid it next time.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4be781df7a1466b872355bf542440f1ce8b278c6.png"][/img][/h2][h2]An easier way to switch between branches[/h2][p]You can now easily switch to the beta branch (and back to the default one, if you like) right from the main menu![/p][p]Keep in mind that this option only shows up if you have the game's language set to English.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/1a575c9d55610266b8ada15b416f6829fc53ea20.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Full patch notes:[/h2][h3]Main Game Version 1.0.0.2[/h3][list][*][p]Added a button to switch between beta and stable builds in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the “Accept all the different opportunity types” achievement being ungettable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the promoted version of Margrave Mizla and his successor giving less power than specified.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Borbak, long-neck liaison activating with Robert Horka’s arrow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mercer Tarcha occasionally not giving armor to adjacent cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the behaviour of Ibran, eager scout.[/p][/*][*][p]Translation improvements for Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Beta Version 1.0.1.1e[/h3][p]You can now switch to this version from the main menu! Alternatively, right click the game in Steam and go to Properties > Betas.[/p][list][*][p]All fixes and changes from Version 1.0.0.2[/p][/*][*][p]Added Necrology, a list of all card deaths with their causes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hugo dying after winning a battle if the card was previously a Papery Infantry.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when getting the revive wheel reward twice with only one dead card,
[*] Fixed crash that occasionally occurred when saving and reloading at the final boss,
[*] Fixed Borka and Geiza giving 9999 base power blood infusions,
[*] Fixed copying a card onto a letter card at the Royal Copier killing the card at the end of a turn,
[*] Fixed nitwits softlocking the game in one-lane battles,
[*] Fixed fomite not getting educated,
[*] Fixed Book of Fungi not working correctly,
[*] Fixed Golden chainmail not updating card’s visuals when activated,
[*] Fixed cards flipping up without being drawn when activated,
[*] Fixed Guild’s token not giving equipment to some cards,
[*] Fixed "Packing a Punch" achievement being unachievable,
[*] Fixed Ipoi not working correctly with Feathers,
[*] Fixed anointed Arkosh having 0% extra power
[/list]

notes.title: The Release Date Hath Been Revealed!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hear ye, hear ye! [/h2][p]
The moment ye have all been awaiting has arrived! Following our grand reveal at the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkAY-R_v4sY"]Secret Sauce Showcase[/url], we are thrilled to announce that [b]The Royal Writ[/b] shall be released upon the realm to all you eager and loyal subjects on [b]August 7th[/b]!  [/p][p][/p][p]Mark thy calendars, for on this auspicious date, all strategists may finally command their full army of warriors in the complete campaign of sacrifice and glory!
